keydlg.lead: This link {START_EMPHASISED_TEXT}is{CLOSE_EMPHASISED_TEXT} your account. Whoever holds it is you. There is no recovery — save it as a bookmark or in your password manager.
keydlg.publicId: Public id {START_TAG_SPAN}{INTERPOLATION}{CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}. Your name appears on public pages only once it has been approved — until then a mask stands there beside this id. To you we always show it.

check.charset: Letters, digits, spaces, hyphen, underscore only.
check.edges: Must not start or end with a space, - or _.
check.repeats: Not the same character four times over.
check.reserved: That name is reserved for the site itself.
check.vulgar: This name goes on a public leaderboard. Not this one.
gate.heading: What should we call you?
gate.lead: The name goes on the public leaderboard and beside every single session in the downloadable record. It is the only thing about you that is not anonymous — everything else runs under a random id.
gate.label: Display name
gate.hint: 3 to {INTERPOLATION} characters. Letters, digits, spaces, hyphen, underscore.
gate.note: A human approves the name before it is published. Until then public pages show a mask — to you we always show it. You can remove it at any time; the sessions then stand under the id, still verifiable.
refuse.shapeless: The name has to look like a name: letters, not just marks and digits.
refuse.reserved: That name is reserved for the site itself.
refuse.vulgar: This name goes on a public leaderboard. Not this one.

fail.nameRefused: The name was refused. Pick another one.
fail.unexpected: Unexpected answer from the server (error {status}). This is not about your name.
fail.unknown: The account could not be created. This is not about your name — try again.

As a service provider we are responsible under § 7 (1) DDG for our own content on these pages under the general laws. Under §§ 8 to 10 DDG we are not obliged, as a service provider, to monitor transmitted or stored third-party information, or to investigate circumstances that point to unlawful activity.
legal.links.p: Our offering contains links to external third-party websites whose contents we have no influence over. We can therefore give no guarantee for that third-party content. The respective provider or operator of the linked pages is always responsible for their contents.
legal.about.p: vriltrainer is a public forced-choice experiment in remote viewing. The expected hit rate is 12.5 % — pure guessing. Ranks, titles and illustrations are satire on the relevant mythology and are not a claim about reality.
legal.licence.p: The source code is under the {START_LINK} AGPL-3.0-or-later {CLOSE_LINK}. Anyone running a modified version has to publish their changes — for a service whose entire promise is verifiability, that is not a formality.
stats.noTrialsYet: No completed session yet. As soon as there is one, the rate appears here.
stats.tails.noteEmpty: This is where players who land clearly above or clearly below chance will appear. About the same number on both sides means: it was luck.
stats.verdict.notable: that is notable — and not yet an explanation.
stats.tails.headWithBounds: The two ends · accounts from {INTERPOLATION} sessions, {INTERPOLATION_1} σ
stats.tails.note: About the same number on both sides means it was luck. A real ability could only make the upper side bigger.
stats.unavailable.head: Figures not available
stats.unavailable.lead: The overall figures come from the server and are not invented here — so nothing stands here while it is not answering. {START_TAG_BUTTON}Try again{CLOSE_TAG_BUTTON}
stats.mine.noAccount: No account yet. Start a session and your standing appears here.
stats.mine.unavailable: Your figures are not available right now.
read.yours.d: Of 10,000 people who are only guessing, {START_TAG_SPAN}{INTERPOLATION}{CLOSE_TAG_SPAN} get a result like this — on luck alone.
trial.starting: The server fixes the target and writes it into the record before it answers.
trial.sealed.note: The target is sealed with this number {START_EMPHASISED_TEXT}before{CLOSE_EMPHASISED_TEXT} you choose. After the reveal you recompute all of this yourself — completely, byte by byte.
trial.takeYourTime: Take your time with the coordinate. Only then reveal.
trial.answering: The choice is on its way. It is scored only once the server has written it into the record.
trial.tooFast: Too fast! At least three seconds between reveal and choice. The answer was not looked at, the session is still running.
proof.title: Proof
proof.eyebrow: The full derivation, computed in your browser
proof.h.pool: Which pool it is computed against
proof.pool.lead: The derivation draws against {START_EMPHASISED_TEXT}indices{CLOSE_EMPHASISED_TEXT} in the manifest. A different manifest yields different images from the same seed — which is why it is rehashed here and compared with the hash that already came with the coordinate.
proof.hashed.lead: Every field is length-prefixed so the boundaries are unambiguous: {START_TAG_CODE}framed(p₀, p₁, …) = SHA-256( LE64(|p₀|) ‖ p₀ ‖ LE64(|p₁|) ‖ p₁ ‖ … ){CLOSE_TAG_CODE} Without it, {START_TAG_CODE}("ab","c"){CLOSE_TAG_CODE} and {START_TAG_CODE}("a","bc"){CLOSE_TAG_CODE} hash alike.
proof.preimage.commitment: The full preimage string, {INTERPOLATION} bytes — exactly these bytes go into SHA-256:
proof.matches: Identical. The target was fixed before you chose.
proof.mismatch: Does not match. That would be a reason not to believe this site.
proof.h.seed: How the seed became the eight images
proof.keystream: The seed produces the keystream {START_TAG_CODE}block(i) = SHA-256( seed ‖ LE64(i) ){CLOSE_TAG_CODE}, read as 64-bit words little-endian. From it, in this order:
proof.independence: Computed with an implementation written independently of the server's. Both are checked against the same test vectors — that is the point: a check using the server's own code checks nothing. The computation runs in the browser; an independent third-party verifier does not exist in this version yet.
proof.manifestFailed: The pool manifest for this session could not be loaded. Without the list of images in exactly the published order there is nothing to recompute — and an empty proof panel would look like a test that passed.
proof.manifest.rehash: The recomputed hash of the manifest differs from the one it names itself.
proof.manifest.mismatch: The manifest delivered is not the one this session was fixed against.
proof.check.seal.ok: The values now disclosed produce exactly the number that stood on screen before your choice.
proof.check.seal.bad: The number from before cannot be reproduced from the disclosed values.
proof.check.echo.ok: The 32 bytes from your browser come back unchanged — the seed has two sides.
proof.check.echo.bad: The server returns different 32 bytes than your browser sent.
proof.check.draw.ok: The seed produces exactly these eight images, in exactly this order.
proof.check.draw.bad: The seed produces a different selection or a different order than the one shown.
proof.check.target.none: Without a derivation there is no recomputed target.
proof.check.target.ok: The recomputed target is the same one your choice was scored against.
proof.check.target.bad: The recomputed target is a different one from the one scored.
proof.note.echoed: 32 bytes from your browser, returned unchanged by the server
proof.note.overSorted: Over the sorted (id, category) pairs, categories first
proof.note.uniform: Uniform over the eight, independent of category size
notice.expired: This session's validity has run out. It counts as abandoned — start a new one.
notice.alreadyAnswered.short: This session has already been answered.
notice.alreadyAnswered: This session has already been answered. One answer per session, and it is already in the record.
notice.answerLost: The answer did not arrive. Whether it was scored, this browser does not know — your standing below is as the server counts it.
notice.unknownLogin: The server does not know this login. Save the link via “Login” at the top right before you do anything else — there is no recovery.
notice.network: No connection to the server. Try again in a moment.
notice.serverDown: The service is not reachable right now (error {status}). Try again in a few minutes.
notice.rejected: The server refused the request. Try again.
meta.title: vriltrainer — a public remote viewing test
meta.description: A public forced-choice experiment in remote viewing. Every session is sealed in advance and can be recomputed afterwards by anyone.

stats.mine.lockedShort: {START_TAG_STRONG}{INTERPOLATION}{CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} more sessions and your figures appear here. Below that, a hit rate says nothing yet.
stats.mine.basisShort: Computed over {INTERPOLATION} scored sessions with {INTERPOLATION_1} hits.
read.chance.d: Eight pictures, one is right. Guess, and you are right about one time in eight on average. Anything above that would be more than guessing.
read.streak.t: A good streak means nothing on its own
read.streak.d: When enough people guess, somebody always gets an astonishing lucky run. That is why both sides are shown above: those doing better than chance, and those doing worse. If the two are about the same size, it was luck.
